text_en: The word of the Lord that came to the prophet Jeremiah concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:
text_cn: 在法郎尚未进攻迦萨以前，关于培肋舍特，上主有话传给耶肋米亚先知说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord : See, waters are rising out of the north and shall become an overflowing torrent; they shall overflow the land and all that fills it, the city and those who live in it. People shall cry out, and all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“看，有水从北方涌来，形成一条泛滥的河流，淹没大地和地上的一切，首都和其中的居民；人们必要喊叫，大地所有的居民必要哀号。

text_en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his stallions, at the clatter of his chariots, at the rumbling of their wheels, parents do not turn back for children, so feeble are their hands,
text_cn: 一听到他骏马的铁蹄声，辚辚的战车声，和隆隆的飞轮声，为父亲的已束手无策，不能再顾及自己的儿子，

text_en: because of the day that is coming to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remains. For the Lord is destroying the Philistines, the remnant of the coastland of Caphtor.
text_cn: 因为消灭一切培肋舍特人，和摧毁提洛及漆冬一切残余助手的日子来到了，上主要消灭培肋舍特人，加非托尔岛的遗民。

text_en: Baldness has come upon Gaza, Ashkelon is silenced. O remnant of their power! How long will you gash yourselves?
text_cn: 迦萨已一片荒凉，阿市刻隆已遭受灭亡；阿纳克人的遗民， 你们要割伤己身到何时呢？

text_en: Ah, sword of the Lord ! How long until you are quiet? Put yourself into your scabbard, rest and be still!
text_cn: 唉！上主的刀剑！ 到何时你才休息？请你入鞘休息安歇吧！

text_en: How can it be quiet, when the Lord has given it an order? Against Ashkelon and against the seashore— there he has appointed it.
text_cn: 但上主既对它出了命，它怎能休息？阿市刻隆和海滨，是他给它指向的地方。
